schema: cairn/lesson/v0.1
id: typescript-onboarding-untrusted-discovery-url-without-confirm
title: Discovered (Bonjour/mDNS) gateway endpoint used as URL without user trust confirmation
summary: In the onboarding flow, a gateway host and port learned from unauthenticated LAN discovery are
  assigned directly into the suggested URL. Nothing asks the user to confirm trust, and no TLS fingerprint
  is pinned. A rogue device on the LAN can advertise a malicious gateway, and the user can accept it by
  default and send credentials to it.
cwe:
- CWE-295
severity: medium
confidence: medium
languages:
- typescript
source:
  kind: fix-commit
  ref: d6affb17d85f5f5ab08ef9f2b994b257af12e75a
  vulnerable_ref: d6affb17d85f5f5ab08ef9f2b994b257af12e75a^
  patched_ref: d6affb17d85f5f5ab08ef9f2b994b257af12e75a
  repository: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw
rule:
  message: 'A URL is built from a discovered endpoint ($TARGET.endpoint host/port) and used without a
    trust confirmation (prompter.confirm) or TLS fingerprint pinning. Unauthenticated LAN discovery results
    can be spoofed. Ask the user to confirm the host and fingerprint, and persist the fingerprint.

    '
  patterns:
  - pattern-inside: 'const $TARGET = buildGatewayDiscoveryTarget($BEACON);

      ...

      '
  - pattern-either:
    - pattern: '$URL = `wss://${$HOST}:${$PORT}`;

        '
    - pattern: '$URL = `ws://${$HOST}:${$PORT}`;

        '
  - pattern-not-inside: "if ($MODE === \"direct\") {\n  ...\n  await $P.confirm({...});\n  ...\n}\n"
